components.name: CodeInput
components.element:
<Labeled fullWidth>
{(({field:{value, onChange}}, [theme]) =>
  <Box sx={{'& .cm-editor': {backgroundColor: 'inherit'}}} {...props}>
    <CodeMirror value={value} onChange={onChange} extensions={[EditorView.lineWrapping, ...[theme === 'dark' ? [oneDark] : []], javascript({jsx: true})]}/>
  </Box>
)(useInput(props), useTheme())}
</Labeled>

components.name: Create
components.element:
<Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label="General">
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required()]}/>
   <SelectInput source="editor" choices={settings.user.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag}))} validate={[required()]}/>
   <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" source="settings"/>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Entities">
   <ArrayInput source="entities" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <Accordion>
      <AccordionSummary expandIcon={
       <SvgIcon>
        <path d="M16.59 8.59 12 13.17 7.41 8.59 6 10l6 6 6-6z"/>
       </SvgIcon>
      }>
       <FunctionField render={record => typeof record === 'string' && parse(record).name}/>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
       <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" validate={[required()]}/>
      </AccordionDetails>
     </Accordion>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Transforms">
   <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" source="parse"/>
   <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" source="format"/>
  </FormTab> 
  <FormTab label="Contents">
   <ArrayInput source="contents" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <Accordion>
      <AccordionSummary expandIcon={
       <SvgIcon>
        <path d="M16.59 8.59 12 13.17 7.41 8.59 6 10l6 6 6-6z"/>
       </SvgIcon>
      }>
       <TextField source="name"/>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
       <TextInput source="name" validate={[required()]}/>
       <BooleanInput source="single" label="Single"/>
       <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" source="options" validate={[required()]}/>
       <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" source="projection"/>
      </AccordionDetails>
     </Accordion>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Components">
   <ArrayInput source="components" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <Accordion>
      <AccordionSummary expandIcon={
       <SvgIcon>
        <path d="M16.59 8.59 12 13.17 7.41 8.59 6 10l6 6 6-6z"/>
       </SvgIcon>
      }>
       <TextField source="name"/>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
       <TextInput source="name" validate={[required()]}/>
       <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" source="element" validate={[required()]}/>
      </AccordionDetails>
     </Accordion>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Messages">
   <ArrayInput source="messages" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <Accordion>
      <AccordionSummary expandIcon={
       <SvgIcon>
        <path d="M16.59 8.59 12 13.17 7.41 8.59 6 10l6 6 6-6z"/>
       </SvgIcon>
      }>
       <TextField source="locale"/>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
       <TextInput source="locale" validate={[required()]}/>
       <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" source="value" validate={[required()]}/>
      </AccordionDetails>
     </Accordion>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>

components.element:
<Route element={<Component schema="page" name="One" id="layout"/>}>
 <Route path="" element={<Component schema="page" name="One" id="home"/>}/>
 <Route path=":schema/:id" element={<Parser code="(({schema, id}) => createElement(Component, {schema, name: 'One', id}))(useParams())"/>}/>

 <Route path="*" element={<Component schema="page" name="One" id="none"/>}/>
</Route>
